deviations: Read only the needed columns of Replication/Data/CSV/pisa_full_gps_final.csv with data.table::fread(select=) to fit the 300 s sandbox limit; no rows dropped (N = 1,992,276).

Natives (Table 1 col 5) defined as migra0 == 1 (1,751,822 students); students with imputed (fractional) migration status are excluded from the native subsample, so the migration controls drop out as described.
Table 2 standard errors clustered by country of origin (as in the text); coefficients unaffected.
notes: Table 1: WLS of pv1math (score/100) on country GPS patience/risk-taking, weights wgtc (student weights summing to 1 per country), controls female, age, migra1, migra2, imputation dummies (imfemale, image, immigra0-2), wave FE, SE clustered by country. Table 2: migrant file pisa_full_gps_final_imcoo.csv (80,398 students), country-of-origin GPS measures, controls female, age, coo_oecd, imfemale, image, residence-country-by-wave FE (180), weights wgt, SE clustered by origin country. Attempt-2 re-standardised the GPS country means across countries (coefficients about 2.6x too small vs claims); after the claim comparison the GPS variables were used as provided (already z-standardised at the GPS individual level and collapsed), and fixest singleton removal was turned off so N = 80,398. The final run was compared to the claims with check_attempt: all within tolerance; no further change. Table 2 risk-taking estimates (-0.194 col 3, -0.382 col 4) are smaller in magnitude than claimed (-0.294, -0.449) though within tolerance.
